## Source
.design/m5/47-trust-model.md — REQ-8, AC-8 + Q3-C + decomposition PR 7.

## Surface
- New binary subcommand: `polaris trust-policy explain <observation_id>`
- Output format:
  ```
  Observation: <obs_id>
  Source: <did>
  Category: <category>
  Subject kind: <kind>
  Created at: <RFC3339>

  Policy applied: <upstream_labeler_name>
  ─────────────
  flat_weight_factor      = 0.85
  per_category_factor     = 0.9   (spam matched in policy)
  per_subject_class_factor = 1.0  (no match for kind=Post in policy)
  time_decay_factor       = 0.71  (age=15d, half_life=30d, factor=2^(-15/30))
  ─────────────
  Final weight            = 0.5440
  ```
- Per-observation weight visibility in case view: each observation row shows its computed weight + a "why?" link that opens the same decomposition inline.

## Rust-quality notes
- **`polaris_trust::explain()`** returns a structured `Decomposition` struct that both the CLI and the case view consume. Per rust-quality §9: shared data shape, multiple presenters.
- `Decomposition` is `Serialize`-derived so the CLI's `--format json` and the case-view API both work off the same shape.
- Per rust-quality §3 (binary): admin subcommand returns `anyhow::Result<()>`; 404 on missing observation ID.
- Case-view extension: extend the case-view DTO with `weight_decomposition: Option<Decomposition>` per observation. Frontend renders the "why?" affordance as a `<details>` element so it doesn't clutter the default render.

## External references
- existing case-view structure: `polaris-frontend/src/pages/case_view.rs`
- `serde` tagged enums: https://serde.rs/enum-representations.html

## Acceptance (AC-8)
- [ ] `polaris trust-policy explain <obs_id>` outputs the named decomposition.
- [ ] Case-view "why?" affordance shows the same decomposition inline.
- [ ] Both surfaces are powered by `polaris_trust::explain()` (one source of truth).
